Regarding Nicola's Foretelling. Not sure if you realize, I may well just be reiterating..."the return" probably refers to the Seanchan. "The guardians" are the Asha'man, remember what Asha'man is in the Old Tougue. This means "the servants" refers to Aes Sedai, which fits with what Aes Sedai means in the Old Tongue. The world not done with battle could refer to skirmishes among nations, or cleansing the land of shadowspawn. The future teetering on the edge of a blade could refer to all the possible wars that would break out if Rand were to die or if he handles negotiations with Seanchan and whoever else poorly. Otherwise, it seems like this foretelling is explaining that Elayne, Aviendha, and Min have a huge role to play in Rand continuing to live after Tarmon Gai'don, rather than something like a body swap (which I wouldn't rule out either).

One thing I have to say: prophecies mentioning the Dragon Reborn's blood on the rocks of Shayol Ghul hardly mean he HAS to die. Last I checked, you can lose some blood without falling over dead.
